definition: Cloud — in sandeśa-kāvya, the cloud is the messenger (dūta) carrying the lover's message to the beloved. The cloud is the vibhāva (determinant) of śṛṅgāra.

sources.claim: cloud as messenger — the genre's defining device

translations.note: Literal 'cloud'; in sandeśa-kāvya, the cloud is always the messenger.
